description: This file declares the FastSourceLineResolver class, a derived class implementing a fast source line resolver for debugging symbols, including its methods, nested types, and friend classes.

classes.name: FastSourceLineResolver
classes.description: A class that provides a faster implementation of source line resolution by loading serialized memory chunks, derived from SourceLineResolverBase.

methods.name: CopyWFI
methods.description: Static method to deserialize raw memory data into a WindowsFrameInfo object.

methods.name: ShouldDeleteMemoryBufferAfterLoadModule
methods.description: Virtual method indicating whether the memory buffer should be deleted after loading a module.
